findings.title: Unguarded reducePrompt/reduceBranch calls
findings.problem: AC15 requires a field whose reduction fails to be sent as REDACTED:FAILED with metrics still sent. Only the per-field loop in reduceRecord has a try/catch. The reducePrompt and reduceBranch calls in OtlpAgentAdapter.buildEvent/reduceEvent, stampCoworkEvent, reduceMetric and reduceSession are unguarded.
findings.impact: A throw in any of these drops the whole event or metric instead of degrading to REDACTED:FAILED. This is a partial on a required criterion.
findings.recommendation: Wrap each reducePrompt/reduceBranch call in the same guard as reduceRecord, emitting placeholder FAILED and logging without content.
findings.check_notes: reducePrompt/reduceBranch are now try/catch wrappers returning REDACTED:FAILED; all callers covered; test added

fix.change: reducePrompt and reduceBranch never throw; failure yields REDACTED:FAILED
fix.test: analytics-reduction.test.ts never-throwing prompt and branch reduction

findings.title: Keep-listed keys pass non-string values verbatim
findings.problem: reduceValue returns any value whose key is on the keep-list as-is, whatever its type. An object or array under a kept key (cwd, tool_name, ticket_mentions, tools, dispatches, modelTimeline and similar) keeps its nested strings unreduced.
findings.impact: Reachability was not confirmed, so the grade is capped at major. If a kept key carries a nested object, free text bypasses reduction despite the 'unlisted = redacted' guarantee.
findings.recommendation: Keep a value only when it is a string or a string array; otherwise recurse through reduction or redact it.
findings.check_notes: reduceKept keeps strings only; nested free text replaced with placeholders; test added

fix.change: kept keys keep strings; nested containers keep scalars and identifier-like strings only
fix.test: analytics-reduction.test.ts kept keys with non-string values

findings.problem: buildSyncReport spans all projects, but isReportReductionOn() reads the nearest project config of process.cwd() plus the global flag. AC2 requires each session's project setting to apply. Same root cause in redact.ts resolveReportPrivacyMode.
findings.impact: Verified in source. A session of an opted-in project is synced with raw titles and branches when sync runs from another cwd (daemon or cron). Sessions of other projects are reduced when run inside an opted-in one. This is a partial on a required criterion.
findings.recommendation: Resolve reduction per session from the session's working directory or project config dir, with the global flag as the floor.

fix.change: report/sync decide reduction per session from the session project config, global as floor (redactPayloadPerSession)

findings.problem: The test 'keeps the same story id and event id' asserts only story_id and the unreduced fields, not event_id.

findings.title: Event key file never repairs after bad read
findings.problem: If the key file exists but is empty, truncated or the wrong length (including another hook process between wx create and write), the code throws 'invalid analytics event key', falls back to a per-process random key and never repairs the file.
findings.impact: Trigger is a first-use race or a corrupt file. Affected hooks get unstable event_ids, so the backend loses dedup for them.
findings.recommendation: Write the key via a temp file plus atomic rename, and regenerate on a wrong-length read.
findings.check_notes: key written via temp file with link/rename; wrong-length file repaired

fix.change: event key written via temp file then link/rename; wrong-length file repaired

findings.title: Unbound session held with no release
findings.problem: reductionField returns unbound whenever status.projectScanned is unset, and the idle return has no timeout. A session with native OTLP but no hook is held with the cursor frozen.
findings.impact: Trigger is a session whose hooks never arrive. Its native records wait until retention drops them, so the data is lost rather than sent unreduced.
findings.recommendation: Release or drop the held stream after a bounded age and log it.

findings.title: Cowork reduction ignores the project config flag
findings.problem: resolveCoworkReduction reads only the global flag and the home-level opted-in list. It never reads the project .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json flag that the hook path and metrics sender honor.
findings.impact: Trigger is a project flag set by hand or committed to a repo. It reduces hooks but not Cowork events. AC19 as written (global or opted-in list) is met.
findings.recommendation: Also consult the project config flag for the Cowork working directory, with realpath comparison.
findings.check_notes: resolveCoworkReduction now consults nearest project config for the working directory

fix.change: resolveCoworkReduction also reads the project config flag of the working directory
